experiment_metadata.title: LeoCC: LEO Satellite Network Congestion Control - Local Build and Evaluation

remediation: Use container with matching kernel version

experiment_1_baseline_cubic.name: CUBIC Congestion Control Baseline (Loopback)
experiment_1_baseline_cubic.description: TCP throughput, RTT, and CWND measurement using iperf3 with CUBIC algorithm on localhost loopback interface
observations: Very stable throughput (CV = 0.17%) indicates CUBIC operates well in ideal conditions
Minimal RTT variation (3 ms range) on loopback interface
Constant CWND demonstrates steady-state congestion control
34.2 Gbps represents upper bound for CUBIC on local loopback

comparison_to_leo_networks.key_insight: LEO satellite dynamics cause 1000x+ performance degradation vs ideal network
